resources.string: Capture, record, assign, and sequence from a single launch surface.
Record five quick voice clips, assign them to the favorite pads, build a starter loop, then capture reactions with the camera.
Tutorial is currently closed. You can start it again any time from here.
Tutorial complete. You can redo it any time to generate a fresh starter pack of clips.
Core studio tools stay accessible. Sponsorship helps fund new work and ongoing updates.
Audio library access: storage %1$s, read external %2$s, media audio %3$s
Using a network-based estimate. This is usually faster but less precise.
Using a passive shared fix from Android. This may lag behind your current position.
Using the best location fix Android has available.
Choose a folder, then record a short WAV clip. Recording stops at 6 seconds.
Recorder ready. Choose a folder before recording.
Choose any destination folder you want to use for these clips.
Folder selected. New WAV clips will save into that folder.
Microphone permission is required before Screen 2 can record.
Enter a WAV file name before recording.
Recording WAV clip. The recorder will stop at 6 seconds.
Name the clip, then press and hold the record pad.
Press and hold the record pad to capture a new take.
Release to stop recording. The take stays in draft until you save it.
Draft ready. Tap to preview, hold to re-record, or save the clip.
Record a take before previewing or saving.
Prompt saved. Move to the next clip when you are ready.
All five tutorial clips are ready for the favorite pads.
Saved WAV clip after 6 second limit: %1$s
No WAV files found in the selected folder.
Tap to Preview or Hold to Re-record
Tutorial instructions appear here while the guided flow is active.
Start by choosing any folder you want for these tutorial clips. The next screens will use the same folder.
You can keep the suggested file name or rename it before saving.
Press and hold the pad to record the prompt. Release to stop. You can still rename the file before you save it.
Listen back if you want, then save the clip to move forward.
Your five starter clips are ready. You can keep recording or move on to the favorite pads.
Your starter clip pack is ready.
Five clips are saved and ready for Screen 3. Keep recording here or carry them into the favorite pads now.
Tap PAD %1$02d so the next tutorial clip has a home on the favorite pad.
Tap the + button on %1$s to place it on PAD %2$02d.

This tutorial clip is not visible in the current folder yet. Tap Choose Folder if your Screen 2 folder did not carry through, or use the folder switcher above the browser if you only need a different folder. Scan Library after you adjust it.
All five tutorial clips are assigned. Save this favorite bank so it is ready to load later.
Your favorite pad starter bank is ready.
Five tutorial clips are assigned to PAD 1 through PAD 5, and the bank is saved. The Load Page button is now ready below whenever you want it again.
Tap the CH 2 roster chip so you can see two channels side by side.
Long-press PAD %1$02d and drag it onto the highlighted step in Channel %2$d. We are building Channel 1 forward first, then Channel 2 in reverse.
Both channels are filled with your starter pattern. Tap Play so the loop is running before you move to the camera.
Channel 1 now plays PAD 1 through PAD 5, and Channel 2 answers with PAD 5 back to PAD 1. Move to Screen 1 to capture reactions, or stay here and keep shaping the sequence.
Choose a folder level using system file explorer, then browse only that levels sibling folders with back/forward. Only .wav/.mp3 clips up to 6 seconds are mapped to buttons.
Soundboard state: select a root sample folder to begin.
Ready with %1$d playable clips and %2$d cached clips.
Soundboard ready: %1$d clips, %2$d streams active, %3$d cached, %4$d favorites pinned.
Grant audio/storage permission from Main Screen to read Music folder clips.
Choose a root sample folder to begin.
Soundboard state: no root folder selected.
Indexed %1$d playable clips (%2$d total) across %3$d folders.
Indexed library is empty. Choose a folder or rescan.
No playable clips in this folder.
Removed favorite page. Now viewing page %1$d.
At least one favorite page must remain.
Delete mode is on. Tap a PAD to remove it.
Remove saved favorite page %1$s from this app?
Target PAD 01 on page 1 of 1. Long press any pad to retarget.
Target PAD %3$02d on page %1$d of %2$d. Long press any pad to retarget.
Favorite slot %1$d has no assigned clip.
Assigned clip is no longer available.
Screen 3 failed to load. Returning to Main Screen.
No columns or rows found for this table. Choose a starter template or keep the table empty.
Start this new table from a template or leave it empty?
Create and switch to a new table workspace for long/short form.
Default columns created for the active table.
Active table is empty. Add columns to enable entry/export actions.
Archive the current table and switch to another active table.
Delete the current table workspace and all of its rows. Screen 4 will switch to another table or create a fresh empty table.
Archived active table and switched context.
Deleted active table and switched context.
Workbook-backed columns apply input constraints, regex validation, and allowed value checks.
No columns yet. This long-form card is disabled until columns exist.
Selected row %1$d. Tap Refresh/Edit to load for editing.
Selected row %1$d. Use Load Selected Row to edit or Delete Selected to remove it.
Editing row %1$d. Press Commit Measurement to save.
Whole numbers only. Decimal values are not allowed.
Decimal values are allowed up to the configured decimal places.
Choose the column name users will see in the table and entry forms.
This is the display name for the numeric column.
Total number of numeric digits allowed. Separators and the minus sign do not count.
Example: 6 allows 999999 or 999,999 if separators are enabled.
How many digits may appear after the decimal point.
Integers do not use decimal places, so this stays at 0.
Allows grouped formatting such as 1,000 or 1,000,000.
Turn this on if you want grouped values like 10,000 instead of 10000.
Allows values below zero such as -5 or -12.75.
Turn this on if the column should accept negative numbers.
This preview uses 9s to show the largest number shape allowed by the current settings.
Loaded row %1$d into long form entry.
Visible rows: %1$d. Active columns: %2$d. Selected row: %3$s.
Required columns must remain selected for short form entry.
This is the first value used by the sequence before step changes are applied.
Choose the first value for this column. New rows will build from this seed and then apply the step.
How much the value changes on each new row.
Use 1 to count by one each row, 5 to jump by five, and so on.
The unit used for each step change.
Pick the time unit to add or subtract on every new row.
Short form appends directly to the active table.
Row appended to the active table. Enter the next row.
Appending row to the active table...
Short form ready: %1$d of %2$d columns selected.
Short form started with required columns only.
Columns are still loading. Try again in a moment.
Update the display name, whether the field is required, and its allowed length.
Turn this on when the field must have a value before the row can be saved or appended.
Maximum number of characters allowed for this column.
Use plus or minus to set how many characters this field may store.
No active columns are available to configure.
Long-press a wav to drag it. Tap a wav to drop it into the next open favorite slot.
No playable wav clips available in the selected library.
These pad assignments come from Screen 3. Long-press a pad to drag it onto the play bar.
Drop Screen 3 favorite pads onto the 16-step bar. The loop repeats continuously at the current BPM. Tap a step to clear it.
Ready steps %1$d. Selected steps %2$d. Up to two bars can stay open together.
Full-width editor. Knobs stay broad while one bar is open.
Split editor. Knobs stack more tightly while two bars share the screen.
Remove saved song %1$s from this app?
Remove saved channel %1$s from this app?
Type a small Tidal-inspired pattern. Use "~" for rests, "( ... )*N" for repetition, and event params like bd{gain=0.8,pan=-0.2,speed=1.1}.
Pending pattern: No queued next-cycle update.
Status: Screen 4 music controller is idle.
Pattern still ready. Sample folder selection was cancelled.
All favorite pad slots are already in use. Drag directly to a step or clear a pad slot first.
Select a saved photo or video
Choose a saved photo or video to preview it here.
Preview could not be loaded for this capture.
Camera feed is stopped. Tap Start Camera to load the preview in this panel.
Camera preview could not be started.
Camera ready. Start the feed to capture photos or videos.
Camera permission is required before Screen 1 can start the feed.
Camera feed is live in the preview container.
Start the camera feed before capturing media.
Camera capture is not ready yet. Try starting the feed again.
Screen 1 now saves photos and videos into one shared folder.
Screen 1 now uses separate folders for photos and videos.
Shared media folder selected for Screen 1 captures.
Photo folder selected for Screen 1 captures.
Video folder selected for Screen 1 captures.
Choose a photo folder before taking a photo.
Choose a video folder before recording video.
Pick one shared media folder for now so this tutorial can save the reaction video with the music playing. You can split photo and video folders later.
Your loop is already running from Screen 4. Tap Start Camera so you can see the live preview while the music keeps playing.
Tap Record Video to begin capturing while your sequencer keeps running in the background.
Tap Stop Recording to finish the clip and save it into the media folder you just chose.
